summary: STORE RUD SKOG SAMEIE (org. no. 976 272 390) is a jointly owned property (SAM) based in Ullensaker, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-04-12. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 02.200 (Avvirkning); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Sissel Rita Øium Rosenvinge Øderud.
